name: 48453 · Marlette, MI
findings: ZIP 48453 (Marlette) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48453 (Marlette) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
